q: Why are comb-plate safety devices important?

ref: Standard escalator and moving-walk engineering terminology and conventional component functions.

q: What does the brake on a traction machine normally do when applied?

ref: Standard elevator engineering terminology and conventional traction/hydraulic elevator components.
n: The machine brake is a key holding/stopping device and is designed to act under defined operating and emergency conditions.

q: Why should elevator, escalator and HVAC systems not be designed in isolation from fire/life-safety systems?

q: Which statement is safest regarding use of elevators during a fire emergency?
